findings.source: TryFrom declares type Error = TextureValueError, but its method spells TextureValueResult<Self>. The alias expands to std Result<Self,TextureValueError>, so it is semantically the same Rust error type; this review does not call it an ill-typed implementation.
findings.governing_rule: crates/AGENTS.md:118-122: cohesive operations use owning aliases, but "Framework and trait error parameters remain explicit."
findings.minimum_repair: Spell the trait method result Result<Self, Self::Error> (or std::result::Result<Self, Self::Error> if qualification is useful). Retain TextureValueResult for inherent/local owning operations and existing public export. No forwarding API or type duplication.
acceptance: Trait associated Error remains TextureValueError and every match arm/constructor/error payload, borrow lifetime and return value body stays byte-exact.
TextureValueResult remains the one owning alias used by ResourceDescriptor and generated texture fetch/store helpers; do not replace those with broad anyhow or duplicate errors.
load_suffix and store_expression retain exact numerical WGSL tokens and rejection behavior.

The existing public staging module can own the alias without a duplicate facade alias.

contracts: TextureValue holds a borrowed scalar ResourceBaseType and closed scalar/pair/triple/quad count. TryFrom accepts only numeric scalar/vector element forms and retains the original rejected element_type clone. Any alias spelling repair must retain exactly the same associated Error and match ordering.

Generated fetch/store consumers use ? or the existing TextureValueResult alias. Changing only the trait result spelling expands to the same Error type and preserves local TextureValueError identity/downcast path.

Staging tickets are session-associated Arc identities with immutable index. Returned byte records remain associated to their staging session. No style alias can weaken foreign-ticket/ZST/overflow/short-prefix/host allocation errors or alter zero logical extent handling.

BufferReadError::Error::source retains actual host integer/allocation, SDK/native mapping/poll/channel causes. StagingError::Decode#[from] and GenerateError::Staging#[from] retain that chain; grouped read errors remain GenerateError, not widened/reclassified by a style alias.
required_dependency_limits: Root current direct Body/Part/Creator consumers still have the already-known old get/status ticket/result API forms and Readback record/read call signature differences. Their complete canonical #780 receiver/caller family remains required and unreceived; the style remedy neither fixes nor clears that integration. Do not duplicate those functions or add compatibility paths.

This is the pre-edit bounded result-style review. Complete focused thirteen-lens inventory before repair, then independent successor reviews and final same-pushed-revision source/CI gates remain required.

governing_rule_exact_quote: In a cohesive module whose fallible APIs share one error type, use or reuse an owning Result<T> alias. Where error types differ, preserve the distinctions with descriptive aliases or explicit standard results. Do not widen an error solely to shorten signatures. Framework and trait error parameters remain explicit.
